atp.key: MSE in km/h^2 of the within-match A - B first-serve speed; 'x_minus_y' = MSE(x) - MSE(y): positive = y better (lower MSE); change_gain_* = MSE(level only) - MSE(level + f_hat): positive = f_hat helps; intervals: 95% four-week-block bootstrap; a tie when the interval spans 0
